regime_context: US thematic tape is narrowing (23 of 49 eligible; momentum breadth 0.47) with Memory/HBM & Storage the dominant, durable leader and Non-AI Software the only serious challenger — but cross-sectional momentum has no validated forward edge on this universe. The one validated leg (absolute-trend gate) is active here, and a 108-call track record with 0.61 hit-rate but only 0.44 directional accuracy argues for deliberately low conviction on direction.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from Memory/HBM & Storage to Non-AI Software: I am watching for Non-AI Software's score to close within 0.3 of the leader while SMH's r10 stays negative (roll-over). theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate validates exposure while the demand cycle persists, since SMH is 'eligible' and the theme is the confirmed rotation leader. Rank #1 (2.363) reflects where flow is concentrating, not a return forecast; the 'trend' hurst and breadth 0.0 (single-stock proxy via SMH) argue this is a leadership-coincident read, not a fresh rotate-in. No crowding flag triggers a size-down caution.
theses.dissent: val_state 'diverging' and r10=-0.1486 suggest recent 10-day roll-over against the score — the leader may be losing real-time momentum even as its durable trend persists, and momentum rank carries no forward edge.

falsifier.text: SMH trails SPY by 5% cumulative over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: It is the only legitimate challenger (rank #2, margin to leader still wide at 1.081) and is eligible with a genuine trend (hurst_tag). However crowding_z=+1.39 (crowded=true) is a size-down caution — never a fade. Position as a confirmed second theme, not a rotation call.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z near +1.4 historically marks attention spikes; 'do_not_conclude' warns attention spikes mark tops. The leader's margin (1.081) still looks decisive, so the challenger's edge is unproven.

falsifier.text: IGV lags SMH by 3% cumulative over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: High breadth (0.818) and 'mixed' hurst with crowded=true (z=1.0) suggest a broad, established trend rather than a fresh move. XLE is eligible, so the validated absolutetrend gate argues the trend is healthy enough to carry exposure — sizing down for crowding, not avoiding.
